halves.name: Old-School Final Boss
halves.desc: You believe in the classic way to love and live, but nobody, ever, makes your decisions for you.

axes.line: You love hard and keep your own door. Close still means space.
You say the hard thing to their face, because that's respect.
Traditions, rituals and how a home should run feel like home to you.

halves.name: Color-Coded Overachiever
halves.desc: You want big wins, and every step toward them is planned, checked and done by the book.

axes.line: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
You want visible wins and a clear direction, sooner rather than later.
A fair process keeps everyone safe. A rule is a rule.

stings: You want old-school love without handing over any of the control.
Your plan is flawless. You just keep not pressing start.
hearts: I can want tradition and freedom. Both. At once.
Slow, maybe. But every step I take counts.

tags.name: Limited-edition energy
tags.heart: I charge myself first, so I have more to give.
tags.sting: Your kindness has a daily cap. When it's gone, it's gone.

youToldGenii.said: Admitted it was over my budget in the chat. Took three drafts.
Sent my notes and a 'you got this,' then logged off.
"I'm fading. Can we do this properly tomorrow?"

tags.name: Moves out, still calls on Sundays
tags.heart: Loving them and obeying them are two different things.
tags.sting: You love your family. Your family doesn't get to pick your life.

youToldGenii.said: Did it anyway. Told them after it went fine.
Say no. I'll find my own place, even if later.

tags.name: Modern for you, classic for me
tags.heart: I can hold new ideas and old wishes at the same time.
tags.sting: Other people can split things however they like. In your own home, you want the classic version.

youToldGenii.said: Run it like home: nobody sits till the dishes are done.
Love it for them. Mine would run classic.
Every relative there, even the ones I can't name.

tags.name: The honest review nobody asked for
tags.heart: I'd rather annoy you than lie to you.
tags.sting: You think the truth is respect. Some people just feel poked.

youToldGenii.said: Told them straight it was wrong. Left on read for two days.
"The chorus needs work. Want notes before midnight?"
Stylist: "The back works. The front, not yet."

tags.name: Actually read the rulebook
tags.heart: Fair isn't cold to me. It's safe.
tags.sting: You trust the process, because you don't trust people to wing it.

youToldGenii.said: Followed it, rolled my eyes, moved on.
Pull up the official rules. Read them out loud.
First to ask gets it. That was the deal.

calls.line: You've said 'can we do this tomorrow?' and meant it as an act of love.
You've made a big decision and told your family afterward.
You'll defend any couple's setup and still picture a classic one for yourself.

plotTwist.line: You'd say: ‘The one I love. Smaller paycheck, happier Mondays.’ Put on the spot, you'd go with: ‘Straight into savings. Future me says thanks.’

said.text: The one I love. Smaller paycheck, happier Mondays.

did.text: Straight into savings. Future me says thanks.
